effectSummary.ko: 현자의 화신이 생성하는 보호막에 최대 HP 10%를 더합니다.
effectSummary.en: Add 10% maximum HP to the barrier created by Sage Incarnate.

prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one standalone HELLSCRIPT passive skill icon, matching painterly dark gothic fantasy game icons. Generate one original square PNG with genuine native transparent alpha. Surrounding and internal empty space must be fully transparent. One isolated symbolic subject. Worn iron, aged leather, restrained sculptural chiaroscuro, crisp broad highlights, dark solid midtones, strong distinctive readable silhouette at 64 pixels. Entire subject including effects inside the central 72 percent, leave clear fully transparent margins. No lettering, numbers, watermark, border, frame, medallion rim, panel, floor, cast shadow, scenery, solid backdrop, checkerboard, matte, or tiny particles. Do not bake any background; preserve native alpha. Output a transparent PNG. Identity (do not render text): Mage passive Sage's Ward, 현자의 수호. Effect: increases the barrier granted by Sage Incarnate. Subject: a single ancient silver-bronze mage clasp holding a luminous faceted azure crystal, enfolded by two thick curved translucent blue protective shell segments. Protective wisdom and fortified arcane barrier, quiet enduring symbolic object, not a spellcasting scene. Strong broad silhouette, weathered dark metal, restrained icy blue light, no writing, runes, book, stars, or frame.

visualReview.en: The blue crystal and protective shells remain distinct from the old grimoire.
visualReview.ko: 푸른 수정과 양쪽 보호막이 기존 마법서와 구별됩니다.

edgeReview.en: Inspected native image and 64px light/dark composites: no visible opaque matte, clipped core, or edge halo. Native pixels unchanged; low-alpha fringe warnings retained.
edgeReview.ko: 원본과 64px 밝은 배경·어두운 배경 비교에서 주요 형태의 잘림, 불투명 바탕, 눈에 띄는 테두리 번짐이 없습니다. 원본 픽셀은 변경하지 않았으며 낮은 알파 경계 경고는 보존했습니다.
